stem: 金融机构在遵守制裁要求时应采取哪一个步骤？

options.A: 若现有客户成为受制裁实体，则将其风险等级变更为高风险并继续对其后续交易进行监控
options.B: 采用自动筛查系统来识别指定人员和实体
options.C: 对制裁名单上的禁止实体开展强化尽职调查
options.D: 本决定经董事会批准后，冻结指定个人和实体的资金或资产

stem_en: Which step should financial institutions take when complying with sanctions requirements?

options_en.A: Change the risk profile to high-risk if an existing customer becomes a sanctioned entity and continue monitoring further transactions
options_en.B: Adopt automatic screening systems to detect designated persons and entities
options_en.C: Conduct enhanced due diligence for prohibited entities on the sanctions list
options_en.D: Freeze the funds or assets of designated persons and entities once this decision is approved by the board
